notes.title: Chibidoki Joins VTumbler!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/67a5ffde2c78f01a65b3d2dbbaecaed862794900.png[/img][/url]

We're delighted to announce the second VTuber to join the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/][i]VTumbler[/i][/url] roster is the small yet loud, energetic, magical girl Chibidoki!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/02efd556cf5a6ab27cea937121b5213e61850fa2.png[/img]

She'll be available for free alongside FeFe in the base game at launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2744110/VTumbler/

Don't forget to check out the brand new website for [i]VTumbler[/i] that recently opened to the public and can be viewed [url=https://vtumbler.com/]here[/url].

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44790642/a28c5d00031ab5fb5a413f71c039c7a543b02a33.png[/img]
